note: Public registers proven to work in this catalogue, with what each can populate. Built from the twenty-nine datasets produced on 2026-08-12 and 13: every lens that came out well was built on one of these, and every lens that came out badly was built on review sites instead. The shelf exists so the next agent picks a source rather than hunting for one. howToRead.reach: cross-cutting means one pass can add a sourced criterion to many decisions at once; single means it serves one decision or a small family.
howToRead.access: api, bulk, page. api and bulk are the ones that scale; page means a human-shaped site that must be read one record at a time.
howToRead.provenanceKey: the criterion key a pass from this register should write to, so the same fact means the same thing everywhere.
howToRead.proven: the decision ids where a citation from this register has already been verified by hand.
